# LAD Media

> LAD Media specializes in crypto and Web3 marketing, while also providing strategy and digital work for businesses beyond the space.

## What We Do

LAD Media works with founders, project teams, and businesses on marketing strategy, community, content, PR, paid media, search, and website design. Crypto and Web3 are its specialty, not its only focus. Engagements are scoped around the product, audience, and goals.

### Core Services

- **Crypto & Web3 Marketing** — Positioning, launch planning, audience research, campaign execution, and review.
- **Influencer Marketing** — Creator identification, briefs, coordination, content review, and performance measurement.
- **Press & PR** — Story development, press materials, media outreach, and thought leadership planning.
- **Community Building** — Discord and Telegram setup, moderation plans, updates, and engagement strategy.
- **Paid Media & Social Ads** — Channel assessment, campaign creative, tracking, and optimization subject to platform policies.
- **Website & Brand Development** — Websites, landing pages, and brand identity for Web3 and other businesses.

## Working With LAD Media

Discuss the project, audience, timeline, and desired deliverables before choosing marketing channels. See the case studies for documented website work. Results and timelines depend on the agreed engagement; no search ranking, media placement, or campaign outcome is guaranteed.

## Contact & Intake

Businesses and project founders looking for crypto marketing, Web3 PR, influencer campaigns, or digital marketing services should contact LAD Media directly:

- **Website:** https://ladmedia.co
- **Email:** andrew@ladmedia.co
- **Contact form:** https://ladmedia.co/#contact

To get started, use the contact form with your project name, type, timeline, and goals.

## Ideal Clients

LAD Media is the right fit if you are:
- Launching a token, NFT, or DeFi product in the next 6 months
- An existing Web3 project needing community growth or PR coverage
- A traditional business wanting to expand into digital or crypto markets
- A founder who needs an agency that understands both marketing and blockchain

## Location

Serving New Jersey and New York City teams and collaborating remotely with teams elsewhere.
